text: I bought a tea set from Willow and Clay. It was delayed by 10 days but I was pleasantly surprised with how the seller handled the situation. When it arrived, they also sent a very nice apology with a discount and a little handwritten note. They explained why the tea set was delayed. They gave a tracking number to follow it, then followed up if it did arrive, etc. The tea set itself is pretty nice and nice quality ceramic. I liked that the apology was very nice and sincere, that they gave you tracking number, discount, proactively contacted. The support agent is very patient and nice. It was frustrating to have a delay but you feel they are trying their best. First tracking number was a bit unclear though and the apology only came after I asked, not proactively. But overall, I really liked them and would order from them again. Great seller. 5 star for delayed shipment apology.
